locator.title: В каких банках можно выгодно купить доллар?
locator.lead: Хотите купить/продать доллар выгодно? Смотрите курсы на Банки.ру!

nearest_text_before.text: Чтобы вам было легче найти, в каких банках сейчас выгодный курс, переходите на сайт Банки.ру!

nearest_text_after.text: Переходите по ссылке, выбирайте предложение, которое вам подходит и нажимайте кнопку "подробнее" — появится список отделений банка с адресами.

inputs.user_direction: Repeat the smooth backward tracking shot as the smiling couple walks forward at a natural pace. Treat the three decorative rings as rigid world-space props locked to their original depth and occlusion order: no independent drift or spin; the right ring remains in front of the man’s right shoulder while overlapping and clears outward to screen right instead of crossing his body.

image_reading: A smiling couple walks side by side toward the viewer, each holding an ice-cream cone, while looking at each other.
Three glossy decorative rings occupy distinct depth layers around the couple; the right ring overlaps the man’s right shoulder in the foreground.
The broad plaza and receding towers provide clear depth cues for a smooth backward tracking shot.
analysis.article_context: The body image supports the article’s invitation to compare exchange-rate offers and move confidently toward a convenient choice; its upbeat travel-like mood makes the process feel simple and rewarding.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Confident forward movement expresses the ease and optimism of finding a suitable dollar-exchange offer.
structured_intent.initial_state: A smiling couple is together in the foreground holding upright ice-cream cones and looking at each other, with three decorative rings arranged at distinct visible depths around them.
structured_intent.primary_action: The couple walks forward together at a natural pace.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The couple has advanced several natural steps while remaining side by side, smiling at each other with both ice-cream cones still upright, and the right ring has cleared outward to screen right.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: The right decorative ring stays in front of the man’s right shoulder while overlapping and clears outward to screen right without crossing his body.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Their relaxed, upbeat sense of confidence and connection persists through the last frame.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, begin the backward tracking movement immediately and match the couple’s steady forward walk at normal real-time speed. Their steps and light hair movement provide restrained natural motion while their shared smile and eye contact persist. Keep all three rings rigid in world space and preserve their original depth and occlusion order; perspective motion lets the foreground right ring continue overlapping the man’s right shoulder before clearing outward toward screen right near the end, never crossing his torso. Finish after several natural steps with both people still prominent and recognizable.
models.positive_prompt: Track smoothly backward as the smiling couple walks forward together at a natural, even pace, keeping their ice-cream cones steady. The three rings stay rigid at their original world-space depths with no spin or drift; by the final frames the right ring clears outward to screen right without crossing the man’s body.

models.scene_plan: Use the full five-second shot for a continuous, even backward track centered on the approaching couple. Let their alternating steps, slight body rise and fall, and subtle hair movement develop naturally while their hands keep the cones upright and their warm connection remains unchanged. The decorative rings do not animate independently: source-grounded parallax preserves their depth order, and the right foreground ring clears outward to screen right late in the shot. End with the couple a few steps farther along and still smiling at each other.
models.positive_prompt: The camera glides backward while the smiling couple walks forward side by side at a relaxed natural pace. Keep all three rings rigid in world space and in their original depth order, with the right ring moving out to screen right from its shoulder overlap without crossing the man’s body by the end.

models.scene_plan: For four seconds, start an immediate smooth backward track at an even speed, using the plaza and towers for clearly visible parallax while holding the couple as the focal target. The pair advances with one simple, natural walking cycle and steady cones, maintaining their smiles and mutual gaze. Treat the rings as rigid world-space props without independent drift or spin; preserve their occlusion order as the right ring shifts outward in screen space and clears to the right near the endpoint. Finish with the couple continuously visible after several steps.
models.positive_prompt: At normal real-time speed, track backward smoothly as the smiling couple walks forward together for several natural steps. The rigid rings keep their original world-space depth order; the right ring clears outward to screen right from in front of the man’s right shoulder without crossing his body in the final frame.
